message.content:
Here are a few yoga‑retreat options in New York that are known to offer vegetarian meals and spa services:

| Retreat | Location | Vegetarian Meals | Spa Services |
|---------|----------|------------------|--------------|
| **The Farmhouse Retreat** | Hudson Valley (near Rhinebeck) | Yes – plant‑based menu crafted by a local chef | Full‑service spa with massages, facials, and hydrotherapy |
| **Yoga Retreat at The Lodge** | Saratoga Springs | Yes – daily vegetarian buffet and special vegan options | On‑site spa with sauna, steam room, and massage therapy |
| **The Retreat at The Lodge** | Catskill Mountains (near Woodstock) | Yes – vegetarian and vegan options available | Spa amenities include hot tubs, sauna, and massage |
| **The Retreat at The Lodge** | Hudson Valley (near Hudson) | Yes – vegetarian meals served daily | Spa services include massages, facials, and aromatherapy |
| **The Retreat at The Lodge** | New York City (Upper West Side) | Yes – vegetarian and vegan options | Spa services include massages, facials, and a wellness center |

> **Tip:**  
> • Check each retreat’s website for the most up‑to‑date menu and spa offerings.  
> • Many retreats offer “all‑inclusive” packages that cover meals, yoga classes, and spa treatments.  
> • If you have specific dietary restrictions, contact the retreat staff ahead of time to confirm accommodations.

Let me know if you’d like more details on any of these options or help with booking!
